title: Gaussian Herding across Pens: An Optimal Transport Perspective on Global Gaussian Reduction for 3DGS
tldr_zh: 把 3DGS 压缩视为 Gaussian 混合约简，用 CTD 做块级几何压缩，10% 图元保持渲染质量
tldr_en: Casts 3DGS compaction as Gaussian mixture reduction via composite transport divergence, retaining 10% primitives with negligible quality loss

key_numbers.context: 3DGS+GHAP 在 T&T 上 PSNR 23.312 vs vanilla 23.785，SSIM 0.818 vs 0.853

GHAP 压缩（无微调）比随机子采样（无微调）在 T&T 上 PSNR 高 4.442 dB
